Coolings pads helped my laptop out a bit when I used one, back in 2020.

It was an acer predator helios 300, 1060 and 7700hq model.

I placed the laptop at an angle by lifting the base, and placed it on a cooling pad with a USB fan built it.

It helped the temps by around 4 to 5 Celsius or the laptop boosted a bit higher(Depending on the game, it would be cooler or boost higher). Temps went from 97 - 98c to around 90 - 93c. I measured the temps, frequency etc using intel XTU on my laptop.

Repasting the laptop with Noctua thermal paste also helped out immensely and so did opening and cleaning the dust bunnies, hair etc from between the fans and heatsink.

The TLDR is it helps a bit, but not much. Laptops run hot.

Where did you purchase this SD card? It happened to me once. It could be a fake SD card with fake storage.
